Job Description
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Job Title
AI Engineer
Overview:
The Global Pricing & Interchange (P&IC) team plays a critical role in shaping Mastercard s economics strategy and enabling profitable growth across products, services, and markets. The team partners with regional and global business units to execute pricing and interchange strategies under a consistent global framework while driving revenue optimization, commercial simplification, enhanced customer experiences, and strategic transformation initiatives.
As an AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in advancing the teams vision of leveraging Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and emerging technologies to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. You will design, build, and deploy scalable AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks, and intelligent automation capabilities that transform complex business challenges into actionable insights and automated workflows.
Working closely with global business, analytics, and technology stakeholders, you will drive the adoption of AI-powered solutions, establish engineering best practices, and help shape the future of AI-enabled decision-making across the Global Pricing & Interchange organization.
Role:
The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and operationalizing enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI solutions that deliver measurable business value while ensuring scalability, security, governance, and regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions to solve complex business problems and improve operational efficiency.
- Build and maintain Large Language Model (LLM) applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, intelligent agents, and multimodal AI solutions from prototype through production deployment.
- Design AI agent architectures, orchestration frameworks, and inter-agent communication protocols to automate business and technology workflows.
- Develop scalable backend services, API layers, and supporting technical components required to operationalize AI solutions.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and domain experts to identify high-impact AI opportunities and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
- Build and maintain cloud-native AI/ML pipelines, model deployment frameworks, and data integration workflows using modern AI platforms and cloud technologies.
- Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices to support deployment, monitoring, quality assurance, reproducibility, and lifecycle management of AI solutions.
- Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and tools through proofs of concept and rapid prototyping.
- Ensure all AI solutions adhere to Mastercards security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance standards.
- Implement Responsible AI controls including bias monitoring, hallucination mitigation, explainability, model validation, and AI safety guardrails.
- Partner across analytics, engineering, product, and business teams to identify AI integration opportunities and drive enterprise adoption of AI capabilities.
- Communicate technical concepts, solution designs, and business value effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
All About You:
- Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
- Experience in designing, developing, and deploying AI, Generative AI, or machine learning solutions in production environments.
- Hands-on experience building LLM applications, Agentic AI systems, and RAG architectures from concept through deployment.
- Strong expertise with GenAI ecosystems and frameworks such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, and open-source foundation models.
- Deep understanding of prompt engineering, vector embeddings, semantic search, agent orchestration, reasoning frameworks, and AI application architecture.
- Strong Python programming skills with experience developing APIs, microservices, and production-ready AI applications.
- Experience with SQL and large-scale data processing technologies including Spark and modern cloud data platforms.
- Experience working with Azure, AWS, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or other cloud-based AI and data platforms.
- Knowledge of MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD pipelines, model deployment, monitoring, and version control practices.
- Familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, cloud integrations, and enterprise application development.
- Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, predictive modeling, deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and statistical techniques.
- Experience implementing Responsible AI practices, model governance, explainability, fairness, and AI risk management frameworks.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into business value.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and thrive in a fast-paced and evolving technology environment.
- Financial services, fintech, payments, pricing, or analytics experience is highly desirable.
- Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, and continuous learning in the rapidly evolving AI landscape.
Corporate Security Responsibility
- All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must.
- Abide by Mastercard s security policies and practices.
- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed.
- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard s guidelines.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard s security policies and practices;

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard s guidelines.

Meet the Team

This Cisco team drives all Lifecycle processes and systems anchored on delivering the best customer and partner experience. Our scope includes Market-to-Lead, Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity-to-Booking, Order-to-Cash, Onboard-to-Optimize, Escalate-to-Resolve, Renew-to-Booking, and Support-to-Advocacy. We offer a unique opportunity for dedicated, passionate, and highly creative engineers to have a wide-ranging impact on our development activities.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer, you will serve as the critical architect bridging the gap between advanced AI/ML development and mission-critical IT Operations. You will be responsible for engineering and optimizing intelligent solutions that automate complex IT workflows, mitigate operational risk, and enable precise, automated root cause analysis. By operationalizing machine learning at scale, you will transform IT environments-reducing manual overhead, sharpening diagnostic accuracy, and accelerating operational velocity to ensure the uncompromising reliability and scalability of our global applications.

What You ll Do

Architect Innovate: Design, deploy, and maintain high-performance machine learning pipelines tailored to support mission-critical AI Technologies initiatives.

Automate Optimize: Drive operational efficiency by automating routine tasks and building robust CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment workflows.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Infrastructure/Operations teams to integrate AI-driven intelligence into existing IT ecosystems seamlessly.

Analyze Interpret: Evaluate complex network performance data to uncover actionable trends, detect anomalies, and identify strategic opportunities for system optimization.

Ensure System Reliability: Develop and manage proactive monitoring and alerting frameworks to maintain peak system health.

Resolve Refine: Troubleshoot and remediate complex issues within AI Technologies environments, ranging from configuration challenges to systemic service disruptions.

Measure Success: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to quantify the business impact and efficacy of AI Technologies implementations.

Stay Ahead of the Curve: Continuously explore emerging advancements in AI and machine learning, applying cutting-edge technologies to drive perpetual improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 2-4 years of relevant experience.

Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python) and modern automation frameworks.

Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.

Solid foundational knowledge of machine learning concepts and their practical application in real-world systems.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a demonstrated ability to identify trends in complex datasets.

Solid experience with Agile development process and ways of working - Jira, Github, Source Control Management.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to thrive in diverse, cross-functional technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

AI Systems Infrastructure: Direct experience with AI Technologies platforms and network assurance solutions, complemented by hands-on proficiency in cloud-based AI infrastructure, specifically AWS, Amazon Bedrock, and Azure OpenAI.

Cloud-Native Deployment: Demonstrated familiarity with cloud-native technologies and container orchestration, including Kubernetes and Docker, alongside proven experience in the end-to-end design and deployment of scalable machine learning models in production environments.

Technical Expertise: Comprehensive experience with AI-native development tools and intelligent agent architecture, including LangChain, LangSmith, GraphQL, FastAPI, MuleSoft Agent Broker, and related LLM orchestration and API integration technologies.

Why Cisco

At Cisco, we re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 0 - 2 Years

Department: Technology

Company: ElevateCareer.AI




About ElevateCareer.AI




ElevateCareer.AI is an AI-powered career readiness and hiring intelligence platform bridging the gap between education and employment. We help students, institutions, and organizations assess, develop, and hire talent through AI-driven assessments, mock interviews, communication practice, coding assessments, and competency-based evaluation.

As part of our growing technology team, you'll work closely with product, AI, and operations teams to build and improve a platform that makes hiring and career development more skill-focused, measurable, and accessible.




About the Role




We're looking for a Backend Developer / Tester (02 years' experience) with a strong foundation in Python and hands-on exposure to Django. This role suits a fresher or early-career developer who has gained practical experience through an internship, previous job, or a substantial academic/personal project.




Key Responsibilities



Develop, maintain, and test backend applications using Python and Django
Work on APIs, backend logic, database interactions, and application workflows
Write clean, reusable, maintainable Python code
Debug backend issues and identify root causes of application errors
Perform functional and API-level testing of backend features
Identify, document, and track bugs, working with the dev team to resolve them
Collaborate with developers and product teams to translate requirements into backend features
Perform basic database operations and understand data flow across the backend
Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and deployment
Work with basic DevOps practices Git, deployment workflows, environments, application logs
Help ensure the platform's stability, reliability, and performance



Must-Have Skills




Python Hands-on experience via internship, job, or a meaningful project. Solid grasp of Python fundamentals (functions, classes, data structures, exception handling) and ability to debug/troubleshoot.




Django Project-level experience is mandatory: at least one project built with Django, with basic understanding of its architecture (models, views, URLs, templates, ORM). Familiarity with building or consuming APIs is a plus.




Basic DevOps Knowledge — Comfortable with Git/GitHub; working understanding of deployment, environment variables, logs, or CI/CD. Docker knowledge is a bonus.




Testing & Debugging — Understanding of software testing fundamentals; ability to test backend functionality and APIs; strong debugging and problem-solving skills; can identify, reproduce, and document bugs clearly.




Good to Have



Django REST Framework (DRF)
REST APIs and HTTP methods
PostgreSQL or MySQL
Docker
Linux/command-line environments
Postman or similar API testing tools
Basic frontend knowledge (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)



Education




B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / M.Tech or a related technical degree. Candidates with strong practical projects and relevant skills are encouraged to apply even without formal work experience.




What We Look For



Strong logical and problem-solving ability
Willingness to learn new technologies
Ability to translate technical requirements into working solutions
Attention to detail while testing and debugging
Good communication and collaboration skills
Ownership and accountability toward assigned tasks
Genuine interest in backend development and software quality



Why Join ElevateCareer.AI?



Work on a real-world AI-powered EdTech and HRTech platform
Gain hands-on experience in backend development, testing, APIs, and DevOps
Work closely with product, AI, and technology teams
Contribute to features used in real-world assessments, hiring, and career development
Learn and grow in a fast-paced startup environment



If you're a Python developer who has built Django projects and wants to grow in backend development while gaining exposure to testing and DevOps, we'd love to hear from you.
